---
title: "Pivoting and joining"
subtitle: "Pivoting and joining data frames."
---

::: {.callout-note title="Where you are in your learning journey" icon=false}
**Where you come from.** You arrive here from [Grouping and summarizing](grouping-and-summarizing.qmd). You can group and summarise data frames.

**What this module adds.** You'll reshape data between wide and long format (pivoting) and combine data frames with joins.

**Why it is valuable.** Survey, experiment, and platform data rarely arrive in exactly the shape you need. Long format is also required for many plots and models.

**Where it leads.** Next up: [Advanced Visualization](advanced-visualization.qmd) and [Manual Coding](manual-coding.qmd).
:::

- Checking a join: duplicated keys and unmatched rows
